Liquid to Liquid Thermal Shock Chamber
Product catalog summary
Introduction
The document introduces ESPEC's next-generation liquid-to-liquid thermal shock chambers, TSB-21 and TSB-51, designed to enhance reliability in electronics by imposing higher thermal stress than air-to-air testing. These chambers are environmentally friendly and cost-effective, addressing traditional issues of brine and power consumption.
Utility and Features
The chambers feature mechanisms to reduce brine consumption by 65% compared to previous models, with options for single or double-liquid brine. Two models are available: TSB-21 for specimens up to 1.0 kg and TSB-51 for up to 2.0 kg. They include an air cylinder system for smooth specimen transfer and a standard recorder terminal for temperature output.
Energy Efficiency
Energy savings are achieved with a new refrigeration circuit, reducing power consumption by 52%. Noise levels are minimized to 65 dB through soundproofing.
Control and Monitoring
The chambers use a color LCD touch-panel system for easy operation, displaying test patterns, temperatures, and cycle numbers. They support remote control via PC and offer paperless recording options.
Specifications
The chambers operate with a two-liquid bath system, supporting temperatures from +70 to +200℃ for hot baths and -65 to 0℃ for cold baths. They are equipped with various safety devices and accessories, including leakage breakers and overheat protectors.
Test Standards
The chambers comply with MIL-STD-883E and MIL-STD-202G standards, supporting various test conditions and cycles.
Safety and Caution
Users are cautioned against using explosive or flammable specimens and advised to clean brine correctly to avoid reducing chamber lifespan.
Options and Accessories
Optional features include specimen baskets, casters for mobility, built-in air compressors, and temperature recorders. Communication functions for PC control are also available.
Contact Information
The document provides contact details for ESPEC offices worldwide and notes the company's ISO 9001:2008 certification.
